# GIGACalculator.com

> > A comprehensive platform offering hundreds of free online calculators, converters, and randomizers for math, finance, health, geometry, and everyday life calculations.

GIGACalculator.com provides instant access to practical calculation tools covering financial planning, health metrics, time calculations, unit conversions, and geometric computations. The site serves users seeking quick, reliable answers to common calculation needs without requiring software installation or subscriptions.

## Core Directories

- [GIGACalculator.com: Online Calculators and Converters](https://www.gigacalculator.com): Homepage for GIGACalculator with free online calculators and converters
- [Online Calculators - GIGACalculator.com](https://www.gigacalculator.com/calculators): Directory of hundreds of free online calculators for math, finance, health
- [Online Converters - GIGACalculator.com](https://www.gigacalculator.com/converters): Collection of free online unit converters for length, volume, data, etc.
- [Online Randomizers - GIGACalculator.com](https://www.gigacalculator.com/randomizers): Directory of randomizers including dice roller and password generator

## Financial & Business Calculators

- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://www.gigacalculator.com/calculators/compound-interest-calculator.php): Financial calculator for compound interest with APY and compounding frequency
- [Percentage Calculator ％ - Percent Change & Percent Difference Calculator](https://www.gigacalculator.com/calculators/percentage-calculator.php): Calculator for percent change, percent difference, and percentage calculations
- [Fuel Calculator ⛽ - Fuel Cost Calculator](https://www.gigacalculator.com/calculators/fuel-calculator.php): Fuel cost and consumption calculator for trip planning and MPG estimation

## Date & Time Calculators

- [Age Calculator 📅 (How old am I?)](https://www.gigacalculator.com/calculators/age-calculator.php): Age calculator using date of birth with Gregorian and Julian calendar support
- [Date & Time Duration Calculator 📅](https://www.gigacalculator.com/calculators/date-time-duration-calculator.php): Date and time duration calculator for time between dates and time periods
- [Days Calculator 📅 (Days Between Dates)](https://www.gigacalculator.com/calculators/days-between-dates-calculator.php): Days calculator for counting days between dates including leap year handling
- [Hours Calculator - How many hours between times?](https://www.gigacalculator.com/calculators/hours-between-times-calculator.php): Work hours calculator for time difference and timesheet calculations
- [How Many Years Calculator](https://www.gigacalculator.com/calculators/how-many-years-calculator.php): Calculator for determining years between dates and year span calculations

## Health & Wellness Calculators

- [Water Intake Calculator - How much water should you drink per day?](https://www.gigacalculator.com/calculators/water-intake-calculator.php): Daily hydration calculator based on TDEE, age, weight, and activity level
